info.title: Hivenza API
info.description:
Run Hivenza from your own code: publish to every network, answer the inbox, open tickets, keep contacts in sync and read analytics.

Authenticate with an API key from Settings → Developers, sent as `Authorization: Bearer hvz_live_…`. Test keys (`hvz_test_…`) work on a test brand where nothing reaches a network, an inbox or a card.

Lists use cursors (`limit` up to 100, `cursor` = `nextCursor`). Writes accept an `Idempotency-Key`. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC. Full guides: https://hivenza.com/developers.

post.description: Makes pictures from a description, or changes one of the brand’s pictures (`sourceMediaId`). The files come back at once with status `uploading` and turn `ready` in about 10–30 seconds (poll GET /media/{mediaId}); a post scheduled with them waits for them. Each picture costs AI credits, given back when it can’t be made (status `rejected`, with the reason). Pictures carry the IPTC “made with AI” label, and TikTok and YouTube posts using them are labelled as AI-generated.

apiKey.description: Scopes a key can have: `brands:read` (See the brands), `accounts:read` (See the connected accounts), `media:write` (Upload media), `posts:read` (See posts and how they did), `posts:write` (Write and change drafts), `posts:publish` (Schedule and publish posts), `inbox:read` (Read conversations), `inbox:write` (Reply, add notes and assign conversations), `tickets:read` (See tickets and requests), `tickets:write` (Open and update tickets), `contacts:read` (See contacts and their details), `contacts:write` (Add and change contacts), `analytics:read` (See analytics), `listening:read` (See listening searches and mentions), `webhooks:manage` (Set up webhooks), `workflows:read` (See workflows and their runs), `workflows:write` (Build, publish, pause and run workflows).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any unique value (a UUID). Sending the same request again with it within 24 hours returns the first answer instead of doing it twice.
